title: Quiz data file
description: Quizzes for one documentation page. The file path mirrors the page path under content/docs, and each quiz is referenced from MDX with <QuizRef src="<path without .json>" id="<quiz id>" />.

title.description: Heading shown above the quiz. Defaults to Knowledge Check.

question.description: The question text. Inline `code` and $math$ are rendered.

code.description: A program or snippet shown beneath the question. An array is one entry per line.

explanation.description: Shown after submission, to explain the correct answer.

optionFeedback.description: Same length and order as options. Shown for whichever wrong option the student chose.

id.description: A stable question id, unique within the quiz. If missing, one is derived from the question text. Set it so that editing the wording keeps a reader's saved answer.

group.description: The topic or section the question belongs to. The question chooser lets a reader pick groups.

level.description: How hard the question is. exam means exam-style.

steps.description: A short worked solution, one step per entry, shown after answering.

source.description: Where the question comes from, for example a past paper and question number.
